fixes.new:
A $$聖天翅$$ of the $$堕天翅$$ race, and a front-line commander who leads the $$天翅$$.
Although he has a wing at the back of his head, his appearance is otherwise the closest to human among the $$堕天翅$$.
Twelve thousand years ago, $$頭翅#pilot$$ was betrothed to $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, the strongest $$守護天翅$$. But since $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ betrayed the $$堕天翅$$ race at the end of the Great $$アトランディア$$ War, they crossed blades as enemies. Yet that love had not faded, and $$頭翅#pilot$$ repeatedly made contact with $$アポロ$$, who seemed to be the reincarnation of $$アポロニアス#pilot$$.
In the course of the fighting, $$頭翅#pilot$$ killed $$アポロ$$'s best friend, $$バロン$$, and seduced $$シリウス$$ with clever words into switching sides, using various means to torment $$アポロ$$ and the others. But when the $$生命の樹$$ withered and the world faced the crisis of its end, $$頭翅#pilot$$ even teleported to $$ベクタールナ$$ to try to stop it. Even so, $$アポロ$$ and $$シリウス$$ still were not in step with $$頭翅#pilot$$, but through the memories of $$セリアン$$ that $$シルヴィア$$ showed them, they learned that the $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ of old had not betrayed, but had wished for the coexistence of the $$天翅$$ and humans. Once they had firmly resolved to carry on that will, the three succeeded in the Genesis Union and held together the shattering world.
Note that '$$堕天翅$$' is a derogatory term the human side gave to the $$天翅$$, and they call themselves '$$天翅$$' (the $$堕天翅$$ side's derogatory term for humans is 'wingless' or 'wingless people').
fixes.reason: omitted subject/pronoun: 後頭部に翅を持つ and 容貌 belong to Toma (male); the entry settles who; mistranslation (wrong referent): 彼の生まれ変わりとおぼしきアポロ = Apollo, apparently Apollonius's reincarnation; 'his' would be read as Toma's (Toma is male)

fixes.new:
The strongest $$守護天翅$$ of the $$天翅$$ race.
Twelve thousand years ago, he displayed his great power to hunt many humans and commit slaughter without limit. But in the midst of the fighting he met $$セリアン$$, a human woman warrior, and the two came to love each other.
In time he parted ways with the $$天翅$$ race and began fighting alongside humans, and used '$$機械天使アクエリオン$$' to sink $$アトランディア$$ into subspace.
In the final battle, it was revealed through the past life of $$セリアン$$ that his siding with humans during the Great $$アトランディア$$ War had been to seek a world in which humans and the $$堕天翅$$ coexist. His determination moved the hearts of $$アポロ$$, $$シリウス$$, and $$頭翅#pilot$$, leading them to resolve to become living sacrifices to save the world.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: 人柱 (hitobashira) is a human sacrifice, not a 'human pillar'; pilot 463 already says 'living sacrifice' for the same word

fixes.new:
An $$エレメント$$ cadet at $$ネオディーヴァ$$.
He has the $$エレメント$$ ability 'Gravity Interference,' which lets him float into the air when emotionally excited. But he hates this power, since it caused others to shun him and led to his mother abandoning him, so he hid it away and worked as a live-in employee at a movie theater.
He loves the film '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$,' and fell in love at first sight with $$ミコノ$$ after seeing her moved to tears by it.
He is a somewhat faint-hearted boy who is easily flustered, but when it truly matters he has the inner strength to overcome his fear and fight.
He used his hidden power to save $$ミコノ$$ from an attack by the $$アブダクター$$, and that act also awakened $$アクエリオンＥＶＯＬ#robot$$. Taking this as his chance, he enrolled at $$聖天使学園$$ as an $$エレメント$$ cadet, and from then on found himself locked in an ongoing struggle against the $$アブダクター$$.
He is the reincarnation of $$アポロ$$, who fought the $$堕天翅$$ with the $$神話型アクエリオン$$ 12,000 years ago, and $$カグラ$$, who shares half of that same divided soul, repeatedly clashed with him over $$ミコノ$$.
But unlike $$カグラ$$, who saw $$ミコノ$$ only as the reincarnation of $$シルヴィア$$, $$アマタ$$ loved $$ミコノ$$ for who she was in the present, regardless of the past, and kept fighting to protect her.
When $$ミコノ$$ was captured by $$ミカゲ$$, who was consumed by hatred from the past, $$アマタ$$ fought the $$エンシェントＡＱ$$ alongside his comrades. Facing its overwhelming power, he was on the verge of defeat, but driven by his single desire to save $$ミコノ$$, he charged in alone aboard $$ベクターゼド$$. His powerful feelings won out, and he succeeded in rescuing $$ミコノ$$. He and $$ミコノ$$ combined into $$アクエリオンＬＯＶＥ$$, putting an end to a myth 24,000 years in the making.
fixes.reason: omitted subject: アクエリオンＬＯＶＥへと合体し follows Mikono's rescue, and pilot 448 says Amata and Mikono completed Aquarion LOVE together; 'He combined into' misstates who combined

fixes.new:
An $$エレメント$$ cadet at $$ネオディーヴァ$$.
The de facto leader among the $$エレメント$$ cadets, a man known as the 'Eternal Number Two.'
A former marine, he comes from a military family that has produced $$エレメント$$-abled soldiers for generations. His good build, wild manner, and strictness toward himself and others alike make him dependable, and he is popular with the girls.
He is also $$ミコノ$$'s older brother by blood. He is hard on her, but in truth he worries about her and only pushes her away from the fighting out of concern for her safety. Because of this, he has no great fondness for $$アマタ$$, who was the reason $$ミコノ$$ became an $$エレメント$$ cadet in the first place.
His $$エレメント$$ ability is 'Despair Precognition.' It manifests regardless of his own will, letting him foresee misfortunes that will befall him.
Because of $$シュレード$$'s presence, he is derided as the 'Eternal Number Two,' but since $$シュレード$$ is often unable to sortie, $$カイエン$$ is effectively $$ネオディーヴァ$$'s main fighting strength. He is uncomfortable with being called 'best friend' by $$シュレード$$, but deep down he feels just as strong a bond with him.
At the final battle, he boarded the $$ベクターシロン$$ carrying $$シュレード$$'s feelings within it, and brought forth a new configuration, $$アクエリオンゲパーダ$$.
fixes.reason: reversed direction: 彼に「親友」と呼ばれる = Shrade calls Cayenne his best friend (cf. pilot 450), not 'called Shrade's best friend'

fixes.new:
An $$エレメント$$ cadet at $$ネオディーヴァ$$.
A cheerful girl who loves to fantasize. She adores beautiful boys combining together, and often gets a nosebleed daydreaming about pairing up $$シュレード$$ and $$カイエン$$. Her catchphrase is 'I'm gonna rot away!'
She also enjoys secretly photographing people as a hobby, and has a formidable business sense for turning a profit by selling the photos she takes.
Her $$エレメント$$ ability is 'Corrosion Force,' which lets her rot and decay any material.
In a mock battle, she teamed up with $$カイエン$$ and $$モロイ$$ to corrode $$ＥＶＯＬ$$'s legs and leave it unable to move.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: 盗撮 is taking photos secretly, not 'candid photography'

fixes.new:
Commander of $$ネオディーヴァ$$ and chairwoman of $$聖天使学園$$.
A mysterious, beautiful girl who is always together with $$不動$$.
She traveled the world in search of $$アクエリオン$$, but upon hearing news of its revival she returned and resumed her post as commander.
Though she looks like nothing more than a girl, her IQ is said to exceed 300, and her age is unknown. She speaks to the $$エレメント$$ cadets with an adult's manner of speech.
Yet she also has a girlish side, being extremely fond of donuts, which are always kept on her desk in the command room.
She possesses the $$エレメント$$ ability 'Teleport,' and at the final battle, after the death of $$シュレード$$, whom she had cared deeply about, she boarded a $$ベクターマシン$$ herself. Together with $$カイエン$$ and the others, she boarded $$アクエリオンゲパルト$$ and fought $$ミカゲ$$.
fixes.reason: addition: 年齢も不詳 says the age is unknown; 'true' is not in the Japanese

fixes.new:
Supreme Commander of $$ネオディーヴァ$$.
He was initially disguised as a school custodian and the like, but returned when $$アクエリオンＥＶＯＬ#robot$$ revived.
He always carries himself as though he sees through everything, giving $$クレア$$ and the $$エレメント$$ cadets cryptic, Zen-koan-like advice that leaves them baffled. But it always carries a deep purpose, and understanding its meaning can lead one out of even the direst situation.
When he uses analogies, he tends to reach for donuts.
He guided $$アマタ$$ and $$ミコノ$$, the reincarnations of the $$エレメント$$s who fought 12,000 years ago, and once the battle was settled, he took $$ミカゲ$$'s soul, left with nowhere to go as pure resentment, into his own heart and sealed it away.
fixes.reason: addition: 帰還した = returned; 'openly' is not in the Japanese

fixes.new:
A priest of $$アルテア$$.
He can use a wide range of psychic abilities.
Deeply mysterious, his capricious words and actions sometimes lend aid and sometimes cause obstruction, leaving even Supreme Commander $$イズモ$$ at his mercy.
He found $$カグラ$$ as a child in the slums and raised him.
He had been asleep for many years, but awoke in response to $$アクエリオン$$'s revival and began to act toward his own private ends.
His true identity is the dark portion of $$頭翅#pilot$$, born when $$頭翅#pilot$$ learned that $$アポロ$$ was not, in fact, the reincarnation of his beloved $$アポロニアス#pilot$$. $$頭翅#pilot$$ himself accepted this truth and became a living sacrifice to save the world, but the part of his heart that could not accept it ran wild and took on a form of its own.
He sought to revive the Mythical-type $$アクエリオン$$ and use its power to destroy both $$ヴェーガ$$ and $$アルテア$$, in order to create a new world.
At the final battle, he seized the Mythical-type $$アクエリオン$$ and absorbed the whole of $$アルテア$$'s energy. He then conjured a black sun to try to scorch the Earth dry, transformed the Mythical-type $$アクエリオン$$ into the $$エンシェントＡＱ$$, and stood in $$アマタ$$'s way. But he was defeated before $$アマタ$$, who sought to save $$ミコノ$$ beyond the bounds of fate, and $$ネオディーヴァ$$, who lent $$アマタ$$ their support.
Afterward, he was taken in by $$不動ＺＥＮ$$ and fell asleep within his heart.
fixes.reason: mistranslation (wrong referent): アポロが愛するアポロニアスの生まれ変わりでない = Apollo is not the reincarnation of the beloved Apollonius; the old English made Toma the non-reincarnation, which contradicts 442 and the glossary note (Mikage is the dark side of Toma who could not accept that Apollo was not Apollonius's reincarnation)

fixes.new:
A young man who runs a machine repair and maintenance business in $$ガルガンティア$$. 20 years old.
A flippant sort, but his maintenance knowledge and skill are reliable, and he has a fair amount of popularity.
He dreams of striking it rich by digging up treasure sleeping on the seabed.
He also does salvage work on the side, but since he cannot dive into water, he is trying to recruit $$レド$$, who has come to live in the $$ガルガンティア$$ Fleet.
He often quarrels with $$ベローズ$$, but they are not on bad terms.
Once, while salvaging in the $$霧の海$$, he lost his older brother to a $$クジライカ$$, and unlike the other residents of the fleet he has no feeling of reverence for the $$クジライカ$$.
After hearing that $$レド$$ had defeated a $$クジライカ$$ with $$チェインバー#robot$$, he broke away from the $$ガルガンティア$$ Fleet, founded the $$ピニオン$$ Fleet, and did salvage work in the $$霧の海$$.
Using the power of the legacy of the old civilization that he hauled up, he made a name for himself as 'Pinion of the $$霧の海$$,' but came into contact with the $$クーゲル$$ Fleet and was requisitioned along with his whole fleet.
Afterward he cooperated with $$ラケージ$$ and rose in revolt against the $$クーゲル$$ Fleet.
After the decisive battle with the $$クーゲル$$ Fleet, he returned to the $$ガルガンティア$$ Fleet.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: クジライカに兄を殺された is the passive (his brother was killed by a Whalesquid), not the causative 'had his brother killed'

fixes.new:
The fleet leader who leads the $$ガルガンティア$$ Fleet.
An experienced leader who always remains calm and gives top priority to the fleet's safety.
Because of bad legs and a weak heart, he uses a wheelchair.
A friend of $$リジット$$'s father, and also a stand-in parent for $$リジット$$, who lost all family.
After collapsing from a heart attack, $$フェアロック$$ named $$リジット$$ the new fleet leader, entrusted her with the 'Golden Key,' and passed away.
After the funeral, the body was given a water burial as the residents of the fleet saw it off.
fixes.reason: pronoun: Fairlock is male; replaces the name-avoiding repetition 'the fleet leader'

One of the great shipowners who make up the $$ガルガンティア$$ Fleet.
He is in a position to guide the entire fleet together with $$フェアロック$$.

The elderly doctor of $$ガルガンティア$$.
He is gentle by nature and loved by the residents throughout the fleet.
He is also $$ベベル$$'s personal physician, and his vast learning has had a great influence on $$ベベル$$.

The leader of the pirate group that attacks fleets. 19 years old.
Dressed in flashy attire that overwhelms all who see it, she not only commands the pirates but also skillfully handles a personal combat $$ユンボロ$$ herself.
She excels at combat command and leadership, and is feared even by rough-and-tumble ruffians under the epithet 'Great Pirate $$ラケージ$$.'
She attacked the $$ガルガンティア$$ Fleet, but was defeated by $$レド$$ and $$チェインバー#robot$$, whose strength was unexpected.
After that, she became a member of the $$クーゲル$$ Fleet, but did not worship $$クーゲル$$ or $$ストライカー#pilot$$, instead working behind the scenes by giving information to $$レド$$ and $$ピニオン$$, prompting their revolt. She personally led the fight, and in the battle saved $$ピニオン$$.
